Name: (1.6) 6480's Giant Crops
Description:
[b][center]﻿Note: Dropshippers like to steal my artwork, especially my giant crop art, and sell it as generic "Stardew Valley" merch on sites like Etsy and Redbubble, etc.
There's not much I can do about it, but if you enjoy my mods and my artwork, you can at least support the real artist by checking out [url=https://ko-fi.com/6480k]my donation link[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/StardewCornucopia]Patreon[/url]﻿.
Thank you <3[/center]
[/b]This mod adds giant versions for 21 vanilla crops that act just like giant melons, pumpkins, and cauliflower. In addition, it also includes a Content Patcher retexture of the vanilla giant cauliflower and melon!

The crops included in this mod are:
Nonregrowable/single-harvest - Potato, red cabbage, starfruit, sweet gem berry, beet, radish, yam, artichoke, parsnip, garlic, taro.
Regrowable/multi-harvest - Coffee, ancient fruit, corn, tomato, pepper, strawberry, eggplant, pineapple, blueberry, cranberries.

Giant blueberry and cranberry sprites were commissioned by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/65802806]Darcy91[/url] for use in this mod.

[b]----If you prefer less bright colors in your game, [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/102170063]xxjasmine[/url] has made a recolored version that matches the darker-toned aesthetic of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4912]cometkin's Better Crops and Foraging[/url] mod. You should check it out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14740]here[/url]!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/14740/14740-1678030818-1681347833.png[/img]

[b]Giant versions of regrowable crops WILL replace your crops! [/b]This means if you have a field of, say, ancient fruit and a giant ancient fruit grows in the field, you will lose your already-grown ancient fruit plants and need to replant them at that spot. This works as intended and is not going to be changed.[b] If you do not want this to happen, change your configuration options. [/b]However, giant crops for regrowable plants will give you DOUBLE the amount of produce!
[b]
Config options [/b](highly recommended that you use the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]):[b]
  "Cauliflower Retexture": [/b]true, false. Turns cauliflower retexture on or off.
[b]  "Melon Retexture": [/b]true, false. Turns melon retexture on or off.
[b]  "Normal Crop Chance": [/b]very high (5%), high (1% - vanilla default), medium (0.5% - [b]default[/b]), low (0.1%), off (0%). Configures the chance of a 3x3 plot of single-harvest plants turning into a giant crop.
[b]  "Regrowable Crop Chance": [/b]very high (5%), high (1% - vanilla default), medium (0.5%), low (0.1%), off (0% - [b]default[/b]). Configures the chance of a 3x3 plot of regrowable plants turning into a giant crop.


This mod does not include any flowers! If you're looking for giant flowers, I recommend checking out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6653]Neo's Giant Flowers[/url]﻿.

Install guide:
- Download and install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]﻿Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
- Download the files from this mod and open them using an unzipping program, or click on them if you're on Windows 10/11
- Drag the folder called "[CP] 6480's Giant Crops" into your /Mods folder
- Start the game, then open the GMCM menu and select your desired options
- You're done!

Uninstall guide:
Break every modded giant crop existing in your game, then delete the mod from your folder.
